texts.facts: The petitioner has approached this Court challenging Exts.P4 and P6 stop memos issued by the 3rd respondent-Pollution Control Board. The petitioner has also sought for finalisation of Ext.P8 proceedings pending before the 4th respondent under Section 138 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. Ext.P4 is a notice dated 02.12.2019 issued by the 3rd respondent, wherein the petitioner was directed to take necessary steps to ensure that waste water and septic tank wastes are not discharged into the nearby purayidom, which would result in pollution of water sources in the surrounding locality. Since there was no compliance of the said direction, the 3 rd respondent issued Ext.P6 order dated 03.01.2020 directing the petitioner to install bio-gas plant and a water treatment plant, failing which the functioning of the unit was directed to be stopped. The learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that the unit is still functioning as on date. Therefore, it is for the 3 rd Sunil V.R vs Koipuram Grama Panchayath on 13 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/188435318/ 2 respondent - Pollution Control Board to conduct necessary inspection in terms of the directions in 2026:KER:2585 Exts.P4 and P6. 2.
